h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Nandyal

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Nandyal

items.pText: Nandyal is a farming town in the Rayalaseema region of Andhra Pradesh, on the way to the temples at Mahanandi and Ahobilam. Many of the playground enquiries we get from towns like this come from play schools and pre-primary sections. They want a small, safe outdoor area for children aged 2 to 5.

Equipment for that age group is a different purchase from a big school structure. Platforms are lower, steps are shallower and the safe play area is easier to supervise. FunPlay Systems makes this equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 730 km away, and delivers it to Nandyal by road. Our installation team or a dealer then installs it. Send us the size of your space, the number of children and a few photos. We will reply with a layout drawing that marks the safe play area for each piece.

richText.heading: What a pre-school play area needs

c: Children under five learn by repeating simple movements: rocking, climbing a few steps and sliding down a short slope.
cover all of that in a small space. A compact unit such as
adds a deck and steps in one footprint.

Keep the play area within sight of the classroom door and fenced from the gate. Nandyal's summers are long and hot, so place slides where they get shade in the late morning, when most pre-schools take children outside.

facts.label: Distance
facts.value: About 730 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: What playground equipment suits a play school in Nandyal?
items.a: Low pieces made for children aged 2 to 5, such as spring riders, a short slide and a small see-saw. A compact multi play unit can replace several separate pieces if space is tight.

items.q: How much space does a small pre-school play area need?
items.a: It depends on the pieces, because each one needs its own safe play area. Send us the measurements and we will show what fits on a layout drawing.

items.q: Do you deliver to Nandyal and nearby towns?
items.a: Yes. We dispatch by road from Vasai to towns across Rayalaseema, including Kurnool and Proddatur, and our team or a dealer installs the equipment.
